model.name: Meshy 7 - Retexture
model.shortDescription: Meshy 7 retexturing: rewrap an existing GLB in a new material without changing its geometry. Drive it with a text prompt, a style image, or 1-4 multi-view images, with optional PBR maps.

inputs.description: Upload a GLB file of the 3D model you want to retexture.
inputs.label: 3D Model
inputs.name: model

inputs.description: Describe your desired texture style using text. Provide exactly one of Style Prompt, Style Image, or Multi-View Images.
inputs.label: Style Prompt
inputs.name: textStylePrompt

inputs.description: Provide a 2D image to guide the texturing process. Provide exactly one of Style Prompt, Style Image, or Multi-View Images.
inputs.label: Style Image
inputs.name: imageStyle

inputs.description: Provide 1–4 images of the same object from different views to drive multi-view texturing (Meshy 7). The first image is the primary (front) view. Provide exactly one of Style Prompt, Style Image, or Multi-View Images.
inputs.label: Multi-View Images
inputs.name: multiviewImage

inputs.description: Generate PBR Maps (metallic, roughness, normal) in addition to the base color.
inputs.label: Generate PBR Maps
inputs.name: enablePbr

inputs.description: Base color texture resolution: 2K (2048), 4K (4096), or 8K (8192). At 8K, PBR maps are generated at 4K and no emission map is produced.
inputs.label: Texture Resolution
inputs.name: textureResolution

inputs.description: Use the model's existing UV map instead of generating a new one. If no UVs are present, output quality may be lower.
inputs.label: Use Original UV
inputs.name: enableOriginalUv
